spans: This Intellectual Property Agreement shall be construed and interpreted according to the laws of the State of Georgia, applicable contracts to be wholly performed within the State of Georgia.

NOW, THEREFORE, for good and valuable consideration, the receipt and adequacy of which are hereby acknowledged, Seller does hereby transfer, sell, assign, convey and deliver to Backhaul all right, title and interest in, to and under the Assigned Intellectual Property, including, without limitation, the Trademarks and Patents set forth on Schedules A and B hereof, respectively, and all goodwill of the Purchased Business associated therewith.

THIS INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AGREEMENT (this "Intellectual Property Agreement"), dated as of December 20, 2007, is made by and between NMS COMMUNICATIONS CORP., a Delaware corporation ("Seller"), and VERSO BACKHAUL SOLUTIONS, INC., a Georgia corporation ("Backhaul").
Parties.answer: NMS COMMUNICATIONS CORP. ("Seller"); VERSO BACKHAUL SOLUTIONS, INC. ("Backhaul")

notes: This is a pure IP-assignment instrument executed pursuant to a separate Asset Purchase Agreement; it has no term or termination provision of its own, so Expiration Date is No. Verso Technologies, Inc. (the 'Buyer') is referenced throughout the recitals as the party that assigned its rights to Backhaul, but the operative preamble ('is made by and between... Seller... and... Backhaul') names only NMS Communications Corp. and Verso Backhaul Solutions, Inc. as parties to this specific agreement.
